notes: Owner: *"having a 'Sector' top level tab with subnavigation that allows us to navigate amongst multiple sectors would be the way to go from a UX perspective."* Done. The industry rung leaves the Economy tab's sub-view and becomes a pinned 🏭 Sectors tab with sector subnavigation: the census strip (each sector with its variables-set count), per-sector variables as per-period series with sparklines and provenance, and the identities-vs-economy readings. The Inheritance toggles stay in the Economy tab — one adoption console. Terminal state reports sectors_open / sectors_selected for the agent con
